entries.definition: Spirit-taught truth and correction received, kept, and worked into proven obedience — the tested, pressed fruit of the Spirit stored inwardly; light is that obedience made visible as an example to others.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: the Holy Spirit — anointing, consecration, and empowering.
entries.citations: (Ex 25:6; 27:20; Ps 141:5; Prov 21:20; 23:23; 27:5-9; Ezek 36:27; Zech 4:6-14; Matt 25:3-9; 5:16) · see The Fool and the Wise, ch. 20, and The Anointing
